notes.subject: ol i ken
notes.rationale: יודו em i jussiv — Tok Pisin i nidim mak bilong bodi, Hebrew i no gat

notes.subject: חסדו / נפלאותיו
notes.rationale: Refren bilong Salmo 107 (ves 8, 15, 21, 31) — repitision i stap, Tok Pisin i holim olsem wankain

translation: Ol i ken givim tenkyu long Yahwe bilong ol khesed bilong em, na bilong ol samting bilong em i gat strong moa long olgeta, long ol pikinini man.

tokens.gloss: na bilong ol samting bilong em i gat strong moa long olgeta
